The actual useLabelTranslation function runs with only useTranslation bound synthetically to the real per-locale i18next instance. This is no mounted React/browser/Workerd or OG image capture; main owns actual SSR verification.

LOCAL_03.clock: FixedDate scoped to each VM; Date.now and no-argument new Date both use fixedNow; actual production/global clock is untouched.
LOCAL_03.oracle: Execute the exact original-B exported formatDistanceToNow and private relativeTime declarations, and the exact C declarations plus C relative-time helpers. A second AST observation copy records only the existing numeric declarations, and is checked against the uninstrumented output. All 16 C traces equal their executing B counterpart; independent literal en/zh expected outputs verify language and rollover. The two components deliberately keep different floor/round semantics.
LOCAL_03.privateFunctionBoundary: history relativeTime is private in both B and C. AST-selecting and evaluating its original function declaration in a local VM is a probe, not a claimed export or a component/browser test.
